summary: The foreign private issuer filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a 30-for-1 share consolidation effective May 4, 2026, approved by the board on March 24, 2026. The consolidation reduces outstanding Class A shares from ~36.95M to ~1.23M and Class B shares from ~580.5K to ~19.4K, with no fractional shares issued. The sole objective is to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2)). No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, etc.) is involved. This is a routine reverse stock split for continued listing.
